## Claude Routing Status

- Mode: `main-first`
- Behavior: Try the main account first. Use fallback accounts only when quota policy or fallback errors require it.

Usage: `/claude-routing`, `/claude-routing main-first`, `/claude-routing fallback-first`, `/claude-routing sticky-balanced`, or `/claude-routing reset`.

## Claude Routing Updated

Mode updated to `sticky-balanced`.

- Mode: `sticky-balanced`
- Behavior: Assign each session to a quota-weighted OAuth account, keep it sticky across transient failures, and migrate only for confirmed long-lived exhaustion or permanent account failure.

Usage: `/claude-routing`, `/claude-routing main-first`, `/claude-routing fallback-first`, `/claude-routing sticky-balanced`, or `/claude-routing reset`.
